source: "Why did you give me this? Why did you do this to me?"
target: “为什么要给我这个？为什么要这样对我？”

source: "Why does Lady Brit act the way she does?"
target: “布莉特女士为什么会那样待人？”

source: "Why is time repeating?"
target: “时间为什么在重复？”

source: "Why were you rummaging around in odd places? What are you hiding?"

source: "Why were you rummaging around in odd places? What are you up to?"
target: “你为什么在那些奇怪的地方翻来翻去？你在干什么？”

source: "You and Brit both often spend your days in the gallery. Have you spoken to her closely?"
target: “你和布莉特白天都常待在画廊。你和她深入聊过吗？”

source: "You know Lady Brit better than most. Do you know what's got her in such a strange mood?"
target: “你比大多数人都了解布莉特女士。你知道她的心情为什么这么反常吗？”

source: "You know Lady Brit better than most. Do you know why she's so ill-tempered?"
target: “你比大多数人都了解布莉特女士。你知道她为什么脾气这么坏吗？”

source: "You know as I do that Gertrude's sister is dead, and you've kept the news from her. Why?"
target: “你和我一样，知道乔特鲁德的姐妹已经死了，却一直瞒着她。为什么？”

source: "You know how Hamlet feels about me. I'm worried the King may act against me because of that."
target: “你知道哈姆雷特对我的感情。我担心国王可能会因此对我下手。”

source: "You say my father has your personal journals. If so, where are they?"
target: “您说您的私人日记在我父亲手里。如果是这样，它们在哪儿？”

source: "You went to school with them both. Can you tell me anything about Hamlet and Horatio's history?"
target: “你和他们两个一起上过学。能跟我说说哈姆雷特和霍拉旭的往事吗？”

source: "You won't succeed with this."
target: “你这样做是不会成功的。”

source: "You're afraid you won't make for a great King?"
target: “你担心自己当不了一位好国王？”

source: "Your Highness, Hamlet claimed that he saw the ghost of his late father."
target: “陛下，哈姆雷特声称自己见到了已故父亲的幽灵。”

source: "Your Highness, I know for certain that Prince Fortinbras is hiding out in Castle Town as we speak."
target: “殿下，我确切知道，福丁布拉斯王子此刻就藏在城堡镇里。”

source: "Your Highness, we need to discuss Hamlet once more."
target: “殿下，我们得再谈谈哈姆雷特。”

source: "Your Majesty, I know that Lady Brit is a spy, leaking information to Prince Fortinbras."
target: “陛下，我知道布莉特女士是个间谍，一直在向福丁布拉斯王子泄露情报。”

source: "Your Majesty, I know you keep a stash of poison in your innermost chambers, and that you plan to use it."
target: “陛下，我知道您在寝宫最里面的房间藏了毒药，而且打算用它。”

source: "Your aunt has passed. Margaret. Your mother's sister."
target: “你的姨母去世了。玛格丽特。你母亲的姐妹。”

source: "Your brother sent my mother to die alone in plague quarantine. Some of her personal items remain."
target: “您哥哥把我母亲送去瘟疫隔离所，让她孤零零地死在那里。她的一些私人物品还留在那里。”

source: "Your brother was apparently searching for a strange old book before his death. Do you know anything about it?"
target: “您的兄长生前似乎在寻找一本奇怪的旧书。您知道这件事吗？”

source: "Your father sent my mother to die alone in plague quarantine. Some of her personal items remain."
target: “你父亲把我母亲送去瘟疫隔离所，让她孤零零地死在那里。她的一些私人物品还留在那里。”

source: "Your father's consort is still alive, but not in Elsinore. What became of her?"
target: “您父亲的伴侣还活着，但不在埃尔西诺。她后来怎么样了？”

source: "Your lady-in-waiting Brit is a spy for the Prince of Norway."
target: “您的宫廷侍女布莉特是挪威王子的间谍。”

source: "Your mother was searching through your uncle's belongings. Do you know what she might have been looking for?"
target: “你母亲在翻找你叔叔的东西。你知道她可能是在找什么吗？”

source: "Your mother, Queen Astrid... I don't know anything about her. What was she like?"
target: “您的母亲，阿斯特丽德王后……我对她一无所知。她是个怎样的人？”

source: "Your mother—Queen Astrid—What more can you tell me?"
target: “您的母亲——阿斯特丽德王后——您还能告诉我些什么？”

source: "Your uncle keeps a private stash of poison in his chambers, and I believe he intends to use it."
target: “你叔叔在寝宫里私藏了毒药，我认为他打算用它。”

source: "Your wife was having an affair with Claudius before your death. Did you know?"
target: “您去世之前，您的妻子就已经和克劳狄斯有了私情。您知道吗？”
